
```{r}

```





```{r}
# Code from alleninstititute scratch.io 
write_dgCMatrix_csv <- function(mat,
                                filename,
                                col1_name = "gene",
                                chunk_size = 1000) {

  #library(Matrix)
  #library(data.table)

  # Transpose so retrieval of "rows" is much faster
  mat <- Matrix::t(mat)

  # Row names
  row_names <- colnames(mat)

  # gene names are now columns
  col_names <- rownames(mat)

  n_row <- length(row_names)
  n_col <- length(col_names)

  n_chunks <- floor(n_row/chunk_size)

  # Initial chunk
  chunk <- 1
  chunk_start <- 1 + chunk_size * (chunk - 1)
  chunk_end <- chunk_size * chunk
  print(paste0("Writing rows ",chunk_start," to ", chunk_end))
  chunk_mat <- t(as.matrix(mat[,chunk_start:chunk_end]))
  chunk_df <- cbind(data.frame(col1 = row_names[chunk_start:chunk_end]),as.data.frame(chunk_mat))
  names(chunk_df)[1] <- col1_name
  data.table::fwrite(chunk_df, file = filename, append = F)

  # chunkation over chunks
  for(chunk in 2:n_chunks) {
    chunk_start <- 1 + chunk_size * (chunk - 1)
    chunk_end <- chunk_size * chunk
    print(paste0("Writing rows ",chunk_start," to ", chunk_end))
    chunk_mat <- t(as.matrix(mat[,chunk_start:chunk_end]))
    chunk_df <- cbind(data.frame(col1 = row_names[chunk_start:chunk_end]),as.data.frame(chunk_mat))
    data.table::fwrite(chunk_df, file = filename, append = T)
  }

  # Remaining samples
  chunk_start <- (n_chunks*chunk_size + 1)
  chunk_end <- n_row
  print(paste0("Writing rows ",chunk_start," to ", chunk_end))
  chunk_mat <- t(as.matrix(mat[,chunk_start:chunk_end]))
  chunk_df <- cbind(data.frame(col1 = row_names[chunk_start:chunk_end]),as.data.frame(chunk_mat))
  data.table::fwrite(chunk_df, file = filename, append = T)

}

```

```{r}
write_dgCMatrix_csv(MO_out1,filename = paste("SoupX/Killi/", "processedrun_WL_killi_soupcorr.csv",sep = ""))
```

```{r}
MO_outsparse = as(MO_out1, "sparseMatrix") 
scdata.MO <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = MO_outsparse, assay = "RNA", meta.data = MO_sc1_clus$metaData, project = "Prairie Vole")
scdata.MO <- DietSeurat(scdata.MO)
scdata.MO <- SCTransform(scdata.MO, vst.flavor = "v2", verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunTSNE(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, check_duplicates=FALSE, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
de.param <- de_param(padj.th     = 0.05,
                     lfc.th      = 1,
                     low.th      = 1,
                     q1.th       = 0.4,
                     q2.th       = NULL,
                     q.diff.th   = 0.5,
                     de.score.th = 150,
                     min.cells = 10)
MO.clust <- iter_clust_hicat(scdata.MO, de.param, "tsne")
```
```{r}
#SC object with hicat clusters
scdata.MO.hicat<-MO.clust[[1]]
```
